data.value: Izi zichotsa HIDMaestro pa PC iyi: makontrola ake a pakompyuta, dalaivala, satifiketi yosainira, makiyi a registry ndi mafayilo. PadForge iyamba yaimitsa injini yake. Kenako makontrola a PlayStation 3, Move ndi Navigation adzagwira ntchito kudzera pa USB yokha. Kulumikiza imodzi mwa izo kudzaika BthPS3 kachiwiri.
